30	 * Returns the singleton QueryClient for browser usage.

35	    // Server: always make a new client (prevents cross-request state sharing)

import { type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react'

// ── User / Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export type UserRole = 'user' | 'admin' | 'super_admin'

export interface EmailPreferences {
  marketing: boolean
  digest: boolean
  scan_alerts: boolean
}

export interface UserProfile {
  id: string
  email: string
  full_name: string
  company_name: string | null
  website_url: string | null
  avatar_url: string | null
  plan: PlanType
  scans_used: number
  scan_limit: number
  role: UserRole
  is_banned: boolean
  created_at: string
  billing_cycle_end: string
  referral_code: string | null
  email_preferences: EmailPreferences
}

export interface Referral {
  id: string
  referrer_id: string
  referred_email: string
  referred_id: string | null
  status: 'pending' | 'signed_up' | 'converted' | 'rewarded'
  reward_type: string | null
  created_at: string
}

export type NotificationType =
  | 'scan_complete'
  | 'score_improved'
  | 'score_dropped'
  | 'team_invite'
  | 'finding_reappeared'
  | 'system'
  | 'score_drop'
  | 'weekly_digest'
  | 'referral_reward'

export type PlanType = 'free' | 'starter' | 'growth' | 'pro' | 'agency'

// ── Plan Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Any paid plan (starter and above) */
export function isPaidPlan(plan: PlanType): boolean {
  return plan !== 'free'
}

/** Growth plan and above (growth, pro, agency) */
export function isGrowthPlus(plan: PlanType): boolean {
  return plan === 'growth' || plan === 'pro' || plan === 'agency'
}

/** Pro plan and above (pro, agency) */
export function isProPlus(plan: PlanType): boolean {
  return plan === 'pro' || plan === 'agency'
}

/** Agency plan only */
export function isAgencyPlan(plan: PlanType): boolean {
  return plan === 'agency'
}

// ── Scans ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ScanStatus = 'pending' | 'analyzing' | 'completed' | 'failed'

export type PageType =
  | 'landing'
  | 'product'
  | 'homepage'
  | 'pricing'
  | 'signup'
  | 'blog'
  | 'other'

export interface Scan {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  url: string
  favicon_url: string | null
  page_title: string | null
  page_type: PageType
  status: ScanStatus
  overall_score: number | null
  issues_found: number
  critical_issues: number
  warnings: number
  quick_wins: number
  screenshot_url: string | null
  device: 'desktop' | 'mobile' | 'both'
  share_token: string | null
  is_public: boolean
  team_id: string | null
  created_at: string
  completed_at: string | null
}

export type IndustryType = 'saas' | 'ecommerce' | 'agency' | 'finance' | 'healthcare'

export interface IndustryBenchmark {
  id: string
  industry: string
  page_type: string
  pillar: string
  avg_score: number
  sample_size: number
  updated_at: string
}

// ── CRO Pillars ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CroPillar =
  | 'value_proposition'
  | 'cta_effectiveness'
  | 'trust_signals'
  | 'visual_hierarchy'
  | 'mobile_experience'
  | 'content_copy'
  | 'page_performance'

export type Severity = 'critical' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'passed'
export type Effort = 'quick' | 'moderate' | 'significant'

export interface Finding {
  id: string
  title: string
  severity: Severity
  current_state: string
  recommendation: string
  ai_suggestion: string
  is_premium: boolean
  effort: Effort
  estimated_lift: string
  category: string
}

export interface PillarResult {
  id: string
  scan_id: string
  pillar: CroPillar
  score: number
  weight: number
  benchmark: number
  findings: Finding[]
}

export type CopyRewriteElementType =
  | 'headline'
  | 'subheadline'
  | 'cta'
  | 'value_prop'
  | 'body_copy'

export interface CopyRewrite {
  id: string
  scan_id: string
  element_type: CopyRewriteElementType
  original: string
  suggested: string
  reasoning: string
  impact: string | null
  created_at: string
}

// ── Pricing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PricingFeature {
  text: string
  included: boolean
  tooltip?: string
}

export interface PricingTier {
  name: string
  plan: PlanType
  price_monthly: number
  price_annual: number
  subtitle: string
  features: PricingFeature[]
  highlighted: boolean
  cta_text: string
  limits: string
}

// ── CRO Pillar Config ────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CroPillarConfig {
  key: CroPillar
  label: string
  icon: LucideIcon
  description: string
  weight: number

/**
 * pdf-generator.ts
 *
 * Client-side PDF generation for ConvertScan audit reports.
 * Uses jsPDF + jspdf-autotable (both already installed).
 *
 * Dependencies: scan types, CRO_PILLARS config, score-utils
 */

import jsPDF from 'jspdf'
import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable'
import type { Scan, PillarResult, Finding, CopyRewrite } from '@/types'
import { CRO_PILLARS } from '@/lib/constants'
import {
  getScoreLabel,
  getScoreHex,
  getSeverityLabel,
  getEffortLabel,
  getIndustryBenchmark,
} from '@/lib/score-utils'

// ── Brand colors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

const BRAND = {
  indigo: [99, 102, 241] as [number, number, number],
  indigoLight: [238, 240, 255] as [number, number, number],
  slate900: [15, 23, 42] as [number, number, number],
  slate700: [51, 65, 85] as [number, number, number],
  slate500: [100, 116, 139] as [number, number, number],
  slate200: [226, 232, 240] as [number, number, number],
  slate50: [248, 250, 252] as [number, number, number],
  white: [255, 255, 255] as [number, number, number],
  red: [239, 68, 68] as [number, number, number],
  amber: [245, 158, 11] as [number, number, number],
  green: [34, 197, 94] as [number, number, number],
  violet: [124, 58, 237] as [number, number, number],
}

// ── Score color helper (returns RGB tuple) ────────────────────────

function scoreRgb(score: number): [number, number, number] {
  if (score < 40) return BRAND.red
  if (score < 70) return BRAND.amber
  return BRAND.green
}

function severityRgb(severity: string): [number, number, number] {
  switch (severity) {
    case 'critical': return BRAND.red
    case 'warning': return BRAND.amber
    case 'info': return [59, 130, 246]
    default: return BRAND.green
  }
}

// ── Layout constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────

const MARGIN = 20
const PAGE_W = 210
const PAGE_H = 297
const CONTENT_W = PAGE_W - MARGIN * 2

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function addFooter(doc: jsPDF, pageNum: number, totalPages: number, dateStr: string): void {
  const y = PAGE_H - 10
  doc.setFontSize(7.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.text('Generated by ConvertScan — convertscan.com', MARGIN, y)
  doc.text(`Page ${pageNum} of ${totalPages}`, PAGE_W / 2, y, { align: 'center' })
  doc.text(dateStr, PAGE_W - MARGIN, y, { align: 'right' })

  // Footer rule
  doc.setDrawColor(...BRAND.slate200)
  doc.setLineWidth(0.3)
  doc.line(MARGIN, y - 3, PAGE_W - MARGIN, y - 3)
}

function addPage(doc: jsPDF): void {
  doc.addPage()
}

/** Returns new Y position after the text block */
function addWrappedText(
  doc: jsPDF,
  text: string,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  maxWidth: number,
  lineHeight: number,
): number {
  const lines = doc.splitTextToSize(text, maxWidth)
  doc.text(lines, x, y)
  return y + lines.length * lineHeight
}

// Suppress unused variable warning — addWrappedText is a utility kept for callers
void addWrappedText

/** Thin horizontal rule */
function rule(doc: jsPDF, y: number): void {
  doc.setDrawColor(...BRAND.slate200)
  doc.setLineWidth(0.3)
  doc.line(MARGIN, y, PAGE_W - MARGIN, y)
}

/** Section heading with accent stripe */
function sectionHeading(doc: jsPDF, label: string, y: number): number {
  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.indigo)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, 3, 7, 1, 1, 'F')
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(12)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text(label, MARGIN + 7, y + 5.5)
  return y + 14
}

/** Colored score pill */
function scorePill(
  doc: jsPDF,
  score: number,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius = 12,
): void {
  const rgb = scoreRgb(score)
  doc.setFillColor(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2])
  doc.circle(cx, cy, radius, 'F')
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(score >= 100 ? 10 : 13)
  doc.text(`${Math.round(score)}`, cx, cy + 1.5, { align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' })
}

// ── Page 1 — Cover ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function buildCoverPage(
  doc: jsPDF,
  scan: Scan,
  profile: { full_name: string; company_name?: string },
  dateStr: string,
): void {
  // Top brand bar
  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.indigo)
  doc.rect(0, 0, PAGE_W, 22, 'F')

  // Logo text
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(16)
  doc.text('ConvertScan', MARGIN, 14)

  // Report type badge
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.setTextColor(200, 201, 255)
  doc.text('CRO AUDIT REPORT', PAGE_W - MARGIN, 14, { align: 'right' })

  const score = scan.overall_score ?? 0
  const scoreLabel = getScoreLabel(score)
  const rgb = scoreRgb(score)

  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.slate50)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, 32, CONTENT_W, 70, 3, 3, 'F')

  const cx = MARGIN + 38
  const cy = 67
  doc.setFillColor(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 0.12)
  doc.setDrawColor(...rgb)
  doc.setLineWidth(2.5)
  doc.circle(cx, cy, 22, 'S')
  doc.setFillColor(...rgb)
  doc.circle(cx, cy, 18, 'F')
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(20)
  doc.text(`${Math.round(score)}`, cx, cy + 1.5, { align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' })
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.text('/100', cx, cy + 10, { align: 'center' })

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(22)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text(scoreLabel, MARGIN + 70, 54)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setFontSize(9)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text('Overall CRO Score', MARGIN + 70, 62)

  doc.setFontSize(9.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate700)
  const urlText = scan.url.length > 68 ? scan.url.slice(0, 65) + '…' : scan.url
  doc.text(urlText, MARGIN + 70, 75)

  doc.setFontSize(8.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text(`Scanned: ${dateStr}`, MARGIN + 70, 85)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(28)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text('CRO Audit Report', MARGIN, 125)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setFontSize(11)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  const titleText = scan.page_title
    ? `${scan.page_title} — ${scan.page_type} page`
    : `${scan.page_type} page audit`
  doc.text(titleText, MARGIN, 135)

  const prepY = 155
  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.indigoLight)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, prepY, CONTENT_W, 28, 3, 3, 'F')

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(9)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.indigo)
  doc.text('PREPARED FOR', MARGIN + 8, prepY + 9)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(13)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text(profile.company_name ?? profile.full_name, MARGIN + 8, prepY + 20)

  if (profile.company_name) {
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
    doc.setFontSize(9)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
    doc.text(`Report recipient: ${profile.full_name}`, PAGE_W - MARGIN - 8, prepY + 20, { align: 'right' })
  }

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(7.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  const confText = profile.company_name
    ? `CONFIDENTIAL — Prepared exclusively for ${profile.company_name}`
    : 'CONFIDENTIAL — Not for redistribution'
  doc.text(confText, PAGE_W / 2, prepY + 36, { align: 'center' })

  const metricsY = 200
  rule(doc, metricsY)

  const metricItems = [
    { label: 'Total Findings', value: scan.issues_found.toString() },
    { label: 'Critical Issues', value: scan.critical_issues.toString() },
    { label: 'Quick Wins', value: scan.quick_wins.toString() },
    { label: 'Warnings', value: scan.warnings.toString() },
  ]

  const colW = CONTENT_W / metricItems.length
  metricItems.forEach(({ label, value }, i) => {
    const mx = MARGIN + i * colW + colW / 2
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
    doc.setFontSize(20)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
    doc.text(value, mx, metricsY + 16, { align: 'center' })
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
    doc.setFontSize(8)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
    doc.text(label, mx, metricsY + 23, { align: 'center' })
  })

  rule(doc, metricsY + 30)

  const legendY = metricsY + 40
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text('Score Guide:', MARGIN, legendY)

  const bands = [
    { label: 'Excellent (85–100)', rgb: BRAND.green },
    { label: 'Good (70–84)', rgb: BRAND.green },
    { label: 'Average (55–69)', rgb: BRAND.amber },
    { label: 'Below Average (40–54)', rgb: BRAND.amber },
    { label: 'Poor (< 40)', rgb: BRAND.red },
  ]

  let bandX = MARGIN + 26
  bands.forEach(({ label, rgb: bRgb }) => {
    doc.setFillColor(...bRgb)
    doc.circle(bandX, legendY - 1.5, 2.5, 'F')
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate700)
    doc.text(label, bandX + 4.5, legendY)
    bandX += 38
  })

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic')
  doc.setFontSize(7.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text(
    'This report reflects an AI-powered CRO analysis at the time of the scan. Results are advisory in nature.',
    PAGE_W / 2,
    260,
    { align: 'center', maxWidth: CONTENT_W },
  )
}

// ── Page 2 — Executive Summary ────────────────────────────────────

function buildExecutiveSummary(
  doc: jsPDF,
  scan: Scan,
  pillarResults: PillarResult[],
  dateStr: string,
): void {
  addPage(doc)

  let y = MARGIN + 5
  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.indigo)
  doc.rect(0, 0, PAGE_W, 10, 'F')
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.text('ConvertScan CRO Audit Report', MARGIN, 7)
  doc.text('Executive Summary', PAGE_W - MARGIN, 7, { align: 'right' })
  y = 22

  y = sectionHeading(doc, 'Executive Summary', y)

  const score = scan.overall_score ?? 0

  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.slate50)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, 30, 2, 2, 'F')

  scorePill(doc, score, MARGIN + 22, y + 15, 11)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(14)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text(`${Math.round(score)}/100 — ${getScoreLabel(score)}`, MARGIN + 40, y + 11)

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setFontSize(8.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text(
    `${scan.url} · ${dateStr} · ${scan.page_type} page`,
    MARGIN + 40,
    y + 20,
    { maxWidth: CONTENT_W - 45 },
  )

  y += 38

  const pillarRows = pillarResults.map((pr) => {
    const cfg = CRO_PILLARS.find((c) => c.key === pr.pillar)
    const benchmark = getIndustryBenchmark(pr.pillar)
    const diff = pr.score - benchmark
    const diffLabel = diff >= 0 ? `+${diff} vs avg` : `${diff} vs avg`
    return [
      cfg?.label ?? pr.pillar,
      `${Math.round(pr.score)}/100`,
      getScoreLabel(pr.score),
      `${Math.round(pr.weight * 100)}%`,
      `${benchmark}/100`,
      diffLabel,
    ]
  })

  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: y,
    head: [['Pillar', 'Score', 'Status', 'Weight', 'Industry Avg', 'vs Avg']],
    body: pillarRows,
    theme: 'grid',
    styles: { font: 'helvetica', fontSize: 8.5, cellPadding: 3.5 },
    headStyles: {
      fillColor: BRAND.indigo,
      textColor: BRAND.white,
      fontStyle: 'bold',
      fontSize: 8.5,
    },
    columnStyles: {
      0: { cellWidth: 45 },
      1: { cellWidth: 22, halign: 'center' },
      2: { cellWidth: 30 },
      3: { cellWidth: 18, halign: 'center' },
      4: { cellWidth: 26, halign: 'center' },
      5: { cellWidth: 24, halign: 'center' },
    },
    didParseCell: (data) => {
      if (data.section === 'body' && data.column.index === 1) {
        const scoreVal = pillarResults[data.row.index]?.score ?? 0
        const cellRgb = scoreRgb(scoreVal)
        data.cell.styles.textColor = cellRgb
        data.cell.styles.fontStyle = 'bold'
      }
      if (data.section === 'body' && data.column.index === 5) {
        const pillar = pillarResults[data.row.index]
        if (pillar) {
          const diff = pillar.score - getIndustryBenchmark(pillar.pillar)
          data.cell.styles.textColor = diff >= 0 ? BRAND.green : BRAND.red
          data.cell.styles.fontStyle = 'bold'
        }
      }
    },
    alternateRowStyles: { fillColor: BRAND.slate50 },
    margin: { left: MARGIN, right: MARGIN },
  })

  const finalY = (doc as jsPDF & { lastAutoTable: { finalY: number } }).lastAutoTable.finalY
  y = finalY + 14

  if (y > 230) {
    addPage(doc)
    y = MARGIN + 15
  }

  y = sectionHeading(doc, 'Top 3 Priority Fixes', y)

  const allFindings = pillarResults.flatMap((pr) => pr.findings)
  const topFixes = allFindings
    .filter((f) => f.severity === 'critical')
    .slice(0, 3)

  if (topFixes.length === 0) {
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic')
    doc.setFontSize(9)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
    doc.text('No critical issues found — great work!', MARGIN, y)
    y += 12
  } else {
    topFixes.forEach((finding, idx) => {
      if (y > 255) {
        addPage(doc)
        y = MARGIN + 15
      }
      const blockH = 28
      doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.slate50)
      doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, blockH, 2, 2, 'F')

      doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.red)
      doc.circle(MARGIN + 7, y + blockH / 2, 5.5, 'F')
      doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
      doc.setFontSize(8)
      doc.text(`${idx + 1}`, MARGIN + 7, y + blockH / 2 + 0.5, { align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' })

      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
      doc.setFontSize(9.5)
      doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
      doc.text(finding.title, MARGIN + 16, y + 9)

      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
      doc.setFontSize(8)
      doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
      const recText = finding.recommendation.length > 120
        ? finding.recommendation.slice(0, 117) + '…'
        : finding.recommendation
      doc.text(recText, MARGIN + 16, y + 18, { maxWidth: CONTENT_W - 22 })

      if (finding.estimated_lift) {
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
        doc.setFontSize(7.5)
        doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.violet)
        doc.text(`Est. lift: ${finding.estimated_lift}`, PAGE_W - MARGIN - 4, y + 9, { align: 'right' })
      }

      y += blockH + 5
    })
  }
}

// ── Pages 3+ — Pillar Breakdown ───────────────────────────────────

function buildPillarPages(
  doc: jsPDF,
  pillarResults: PillarResult[],
): void {
  const sortedPillars = [...pillarResults].sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score)

  sortedPillars.forEach((pillar) => {
    addPage(doc)

    let y = 10

    const rgb = scoreRgb(pillar.score)
    doc.setFillColor(...rgb)
    doc.rect(0, 0, PAGE_W, 12, 'F')
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
    doc.setFontSize(9)
    const cfg = CRO_PILLARS.find((c) => c.key === pillar.pillar)
    const pillarLabel = cfg?.label ?? pillar.pillar
    doc.text(`ConvertScan · ${pillarLabel}`, MARGIN, 8.5)
    doc.text(`Score: ${Math.round(pillar.score)}/100`, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 8.5, { align: 'right' })

    y = 22

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
    doc.setFontSize(16)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
    doc.text(pillarLabel, MARGIN, y + 7)

    scorePill(doc, pillar.score, PAGE_W - MARGIN - 16, y + 3, 10)

    y += 16

    const benchmark = getIndustryBenchmark(pillar.pillar)
    doc.setFontSize(8)
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
    doc.text(`Industry average: ${benchmark}/100`, MARGIN, y + 5)
    const diff = pillar.score - benchmark
    const diffLabel = diff >= 0 ? `${diff} points above average` : `${Math.abs(diff)} points below average`
    doc.setTextColor(diff >= 0 ? BRAND.green[0] : BRAND.red[0], diff >= 0 ? BRAND.green[1] : BRAND.red[1], diff >= 0 ? BRAND.green[2] : BRAND.red[2])
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
    doc.text(diffLabel, MARGIN + 60, y + 5)

    y += 12

    const barW = CONTENT_W * 0.7
    doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.slate200)
    doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, barW, 5, 2, 2, 'F')
    const filledW = (pillar.score / 100) * barW
    doc.setFillColor(...rgb)
    doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, filledW, 5, 2, 2, 'F')
    const markerX = MARGIN + (benchmark / 100) * barW
    doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.slate700)
    doc.rect(markerX - 0.5, y - 1, 1, 7, 'F')

    y += 14
    rule(doc, y)
    y += 8

    const findings = pillar.findings.filter((f) => f.severity !== 'passed')

    if (findings.length === 0) {
      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic')
      doc.setFontSize(9)
      doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
      doc.text('No issues found for this pillar.', MARGIN, y + 6)
      return
    }

    findings.forEach((finding) => {
      const neededH = estimateFindingHeight(finding)
      if (y + neededH > 270) {
        addPage(doc)
        y = MARGIN + 5
        doc.setFillColor(...rgb)
        doc.rect(0, 0, PAGE_W, 8, 'F')
        doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.white)
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
        doc.setFontSize(7.5)
        doc.text(`ConvertScan · ${pillarLabel} (continued)`, MARGIN, 6)
        y = 16
      }

      y = renderFinding(doc, finding, y)
      y += 6
    })
  })
}

/** Rough height estimate for a finding block in pt */
function estimateFindingHeight(finding: Finding): number {
  const hasAI = !finding.is_premium && finding.ai_suggestion
  return hasAI ? 80 : 62
}

/** Renders a single finding block, returns new Y position */
function renderFinding(doc: jsPDF, finding: Finding, startY: number): number {
  const sevRgb = severityRgb(finding.severity)
  let y = startY

  doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.white)
  doc.setDrawColor(...BRAND.slate200)
  doc.setLineWidth(0.3)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, estimateFindingHeight(finding), 2, 2, 'FD')

  doc.setFillColor(...sevRgb)
  doc.roundedRect(MARGIN, y, 3.5, estimateFindingHeight(finding), 1, 1, 'F')

  const innerX = MARGIN + 8
  const innerW = CONTENT_W - 14
  y += 8

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(9.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate900)
  doc.text(finding.title, innerX, y)

  const sevLabel = getSeverityLabel(finding.severity)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(7.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...sevRgb)
  const badgeX = PAGE_W - MARGIN - 4
  doc.text(sevLabel.toUpperCase(), badgeX, y, { align: 'right' })

  y += 7

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setFontSize(7.5)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text(`Effort: ${getEffortLabel(finding.effort)}`, innerX, y)
  if (finding.estimated_lift) {
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.violet)
    doc.text(`Est. lift: ${finding.estimated_lift}`, innerX + 50, y)
  }
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  doc.text(`Category: ${finding.category}`, innerX + 110, y)

  y += 7

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate700)
  doc.text('Current:', innerX, y)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  const currentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(finding.current_state, innerW - 22)
  const clampedCurrentLines = currentLines.slice(0, 2)
  doc.text(clampedCurrentLines, innerX + 22, y)
  y += clampedCurrentLines.length * 4.5 + 3

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
  doc.setFontSize(8)
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate700)
  doc.text('Fix:', innerX, y)
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
  doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate500)
  const recLines = doc.splitTextToSize(finding.recommendation, innerW - 22)
  const clampedRecLines = recLines.slice(0, 2)
  doc.text(clampedRecLines, innerX + 22, y)
  y += clampedRecLines.length * 4.5 + 3

  if (!finding.is_premium && finding.ai_suggestion) {
    doc.setFillColor(...BRAND.indigoLight)
    const aiBoxH = 14
    doc.roundedRect(innerX, y, innerW, aiBoxH, 1.5, 1.5, 'F')

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold')
    doc.setFontSize(7.5)
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.indigo)
    doc.text('AI:', innerX + 4, y + 5.5)

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal')
    doc.setTextColor(...BRAND.slate700)
    const aiText = finding.ai_suggestion.length > 140
      ? finding.ai_suggestion.slice(0, 137) + '…'
      : finding.ai_suggestion
    const aiLines = doc.splitTextToSize(aiText, innerW - 16)
    doc.text(aiLines.slice(0, 2), innerX + 12, y + 5.5)
    y += aiBoxH + 2
  }

  return y
}

/** Hex "#RRGGBB" → [R, G, B] tuple. Falls back to BRAND.indigo on invalid input. */
function hexToRgb(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const cleaned = hex.replace('#', '')
  if (cleaned.length !== 6) return BRAND.indigo
  const r = parseInt(cleaned.slice(0, 2), 16)
  const g = parseInt(cleaned.slice(2, 4), 16)
  const b = parseInt(cleaned.slice(4, 6), 16)
  if (Number.isNaN(r) || Number.isNaN(g) || Number.isNaN(b)) return BRAND.indigo
  return [r, g, b]
}

function enhancedScoreInterpretation(score: number): string {
  if (score >= 85) return 'Excellent'
  if (score >= 70) return 'Good'
  if (score >= 55) return 'Average'
  if (score >= 40) return 'Below Average'
  return 'Critical'
}

  const { scan, pillarResults, copyRewrites, scoreHistory, branding } = options

  const doc = new jsPDF({ unit: 'mm', format: 'a4', orientation: 'portrait' })

  const scanDate = scan.completed_at ?? scan.created_at
  const dateStr = new Date(scanDate).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {

  const accent: [number, number, number] = branding?.accentColor

  }

    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/g, '-')
